label: SafetyComplianceWorkforce process: Coordinate product and material changes for safety — Align engineering changes and material substitutions with safety requirements to eliminate or reduce hazardous substances in products.

trace.picked_reason: Best resource for SafetyComplianceWorkforce process. The SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator agent is specifically designed to coordinate product and material changes for safety by: (1) automating safety validation across engineering changes and materials; (2) validating engineering changes and assessing material safety; (3) coordinating compliance workflows; (4) automating BOM validation; (5) exposing all required entity types (EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem); and (6) initiating compliance remediation when safety risks are detected—directly aligned with eliminating/reducing hazardous substances.
